basic_details.job_title: PAJANCOA & RI Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One Consultant post on contract basis, in the grade of Junior Accounts Officer, is open to retired Junior Accounts Officers at Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru College of Agriculture and Research Institute (PAJANCOA & RI), Karaikal, Puducherry. The application, on the Annexure-1 form, goes to The Dean of the college in an envelope superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CONSULTANT" on or before 26 November 2026. The engagement is for six months, and the age must not exceed 65 years.

qualification.details: There is one post: Consultant (01 post), engaged on contract basis in the grade of Junior Accounts Officer. Only retired officials are invited. | Eligibility: Should be a retired Govt. Official in the Grade of Junior Accounts Officer. Age limit: Not exceeding 65 years, as per the post table. The terms and conditions annexed to the notification describe it as "below 65 years of age". The notice prints no cut-off date for age and no age relaxation. Required knowledge: Shall be conversant in dealing with Court Cases, Disciplinary Cases, Establishment and Accounts related duties. Experience: Should have work experience in the grade of Junior Accounts Officer in "Puducherry Admission" (as printed in the notice). Preference: Preference will be given to applicants who have work experience in Govt. run Educational Institutions and Autonomous Educational Institutes of Government of Puducherry. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the application form asks applicants to state their educational qualification and computer knowledge. | Pay (fee) and allowances: The Consultant's fee is not to exceed the ceiling of Last Pay Drawn minus pension. No allowances are admissible except TA on official tour as applicable to a Govt. Officer holding an equal post on regular basis. The agreement proforma also states that T.A./D.A. on official tour will be paid as per the entitlement of his/her counterpart in Government. The notice prints no fixed monthly amount. | For the full eligibility conditions of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

selection_process: Applications received will be short listed by the Consultancy Evaluation Committee

and selection is subject to concurrence of the Finance Department and approval by the competent authority. The selection procedure and other terms and conditions follow the guidelines stipulated in I.D.Note/Memorandum No.46324/FD/F3/2026 dated 27-08-2026. On selection
the official shall execute an agreement in the prescribed form (Annexure-II).
important_instructions: The engagement is for six months at the initial stage and is extendable to 6 monthly periods subject to assessment of performance. The appointment of the Consultant shall be purely of temporary nature against the specific jobs, subject to execution of the agreement. The appointment will be cancelled at any time by the employer without assigning any reason. The retired Govt. Official shall not take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy. Leave: twelve (12) days in a calendar year on pro-rata basis. The agreement proforma states that the consultancy service will be on full time basis and that the Consultant will report to the officer named in the agreement. The terms are framed in terms of provisions of GFR 2017; other conditions stipulated in ID Note/Memorandum No.46324/FD/F3/2026 dated 27-08-2026 apply.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The duly filled in application form, as prescribed in Annexure-1 of the notification, may be submitted to this address: The Dean, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru College of Agriculture and Research Institute, Serumavilangai, Karaikal Write on the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CONSULTANT". Last date: on or before 26 November 2026. Form to use: the Annexure-1 proforma "Application for Engagement of Retired Govt. Officials as Consultant in Govt. Departments/Autonomous Bodies", printed with the notification. The notice does not mention a postal mode such as speed post or registered post. The Annexure-1 form asks for the applicant's name, date of birth, address for communication, contact number, e-mail ID, particulars of Government service (date of joining, date of retirement and the post in which retired, the department or organisation from which retired, and last pay drawn), educational qualification, details of knowledge in computer, experience with the nature of duties performed (starting from the last appointment, giving ministry/department, period, post held and nature of work), and any additional information supporting suitability for the post. The applicant signs a declaration that the particulars are true and that he or she was clear from vigilance angle at the time of retirement.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post: Consultant (01 post), engaged on contract basis in the grade of Junior Accounts Officer. Only retired officials are invited. Eligibility: Should be a retired Govt. Official in the Grade of Junior Accounts Officer. Age limit: Not exceeding 65 years, as per the post table. The terms and conditions annexed to the notification describe it as "below 65 years of age". The notice prints no cut-off date for age and no age relaxation. Required knowledge: Shall be conversant in dealing with Court Cases, Disciplinary Cases, Establishment and Accounts related duties. Experience: Should have work experience in the grade of Junior Accounts Officer in "Puducherry Admission" (as printed in the notice). Preference: Preference will be given to applicants who have work experience in Govt. run Educational Institutions and Autonomous Educational Institutes of Government of Puducherry. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the application form asks applicants to state their educational qualification and computer knowledge. Pay (fee) and allowances: The Consultant's fee is not to exceed the ceiling of Last Pay Drawn minus pension. No allowances are admissible except TA on official tour as applicable to a Govt. Officer holding an equal post on regular basis. The agreement proforma also states that T.A./D.A. on official tour will be paid as per the entitlement of his/her counterpart in Government. The notice prints no fixed monthly amount. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: PAJANCOA & RI Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: Under "Service to be Performed and scope or required work", the notice lists: Preparation of replies to pending AG and Internal Audit Para's Preparation of Counter affidavit to the court cases Dealing with disciplinary cases Verification of Accounts related to college Revenue Receipt and all Scheme related Accounts Any other duties entrusted by the Dean

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application form as prescribed in Annexure-1, duly filled in and signed with date and place Recent passport size photo pasted on the form Copy of PPO (to be enclosed with the last pay drawn details)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received will be short listed by the Consultancy Evaluation Committee, and selection is subject to concurrence of the Finance Department and approval by the competent authority. The selection procedure and other terms and conditions follow the guidelines stipulated in I.D.Note/Memorandum No.46324/FD/F3/2026 dated 27-08-2026. On selection, the official shall execute an agreement in the prescribed form (Annexure-II).

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is for six months at the initial stage and is extendable to 6 monthly periods subject to assessment of performance. The appointment of the Consultant shall be purely of temporary nature against the specific jobs, subject to execution of the agreement. The appointment will be cancelled at any time by the employer without assigning any reason. The retired Govt. Official shall not take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy. Leave: twelve (12) days in a calendar year on pro-rata basis. The agreement proforma states that the consultancy service will be on full time basis and that the Consultant will report to the officer named in the agreement. The terms are framed in terms of provisions of GFR 2017; other conditions stipulated in ID Note/Memorandum No.46324/FD/F3/2026 dated 27-08-2026 apply.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PAJANCOA & RI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Consultant post, on contract basis in the grade of Junior Accounts Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the PAJANCOA & RI Consultant post?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted to The Dean on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the PAJANCOA & RI Consultant post?
faq.answer: A retired Govt. Official in the grade of Junior Accounts Officer, conversant in dealing with Court Cases, Disciplinary Cases, Establishment and Accounts related duties, with work experience in the grade of Junior Accounts Officer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the PAJANCOA & RI Consultant post?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 65 years, as per the post table; the annexed terms describe it as below 65 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. Can retired employees apply, and how is their pay fixed?
faq.answer: Yes, only retired Junior Accounts Officers are invited. The Consultant's fee is not to exceed the ceiling of Last Pay Drawn minus pension.

faq.question: Q6. Are any allowances paid to the PAJANCOA & RI Consultant?
faq.answer: No allowances are admissible except TA on official tour as applicable to a Govt. Officer holding an equal post on regular basis.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for the PAJANCOA & RI Consultant post?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-1 form, paste a recent passport size photo, enclose a copy of the PPO and submit it to The Dean, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru College of Agriculture and Research Institute, Serumavilangai, Karaikal, with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CONSULTANT" written on the envelope.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the PAJANCOA & RI Consultant?
faq.answer: Applications will be short listed by the Consultancy Evaluation Committee, subject to concurrence of the Finance Department and approval by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q9. Is the PAJANCOA & RI Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely temporary on contract basis for six months at the initial stage, extendable to 6 monthly periods subject to assessment of performance, and can be cancelled at any time without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q10. How much leave does the PAJANCOA & RI Consultant get?
faq.answer: The Consultant is entitled to twelve (12) days of leave in a calendar year on pro-rata basis.
